# Collector's Briefing: Chennai district
_Last 7 days, data as of 2026-10-01 09:41:00_
## At a glance
- 1,191 incidents were reported in Chennai district (last 7 days), 12% fewer than the previous period.
- 1,039 incidents are still open, 246 of them past the deadline; 43 severe events.
- 42 incidents came from more than one source, and 132 incidents appear only in the news.
- Conditions: rainfall 0 mm in 24 h, air quality 84 AQI, reservoirs 96.7% full.
- Markets: Tomato ₹31/kg across 8 Chennai markets (₹23 at Medavakkam to ₹34 at K.K. Nagar), up 3% on the previous report; Onion ₹60/kg across 8 Chennai markets (₹50 at Kundrathur to ₹70 at K.K. Nagar); Potato ₹36/kg across 8 Chennai markets (₹28 at Pallavaram to ₹64 at Anna Nagar), down 7% on the previous report.

1. **Lakes, bunds & sluices – Porur (Porur Lake Bund)** (Severe, Valasaravakkam; In progress). What happened: Bund breach at Porur (Porur Lake Bund), Valasaravakkam.
